name: Llm Wiki
description: Maintains docs/wiki/ as a DAG of LLM-authored pages kept in sync with the codebase. Tracks code changes via PostToolUse hooks, reconciles stale pages through background agents, lints the wiki graph, and supports EIS (Executable Implementation Spec) authoring.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**, **4 agents**, **8 commands** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (3): `eis-writing` (Use when authoring a new Executable Implementation Spec (EIS) from a natural-language description), `entity-map` (Canonical enumeration of project Prisma models, API routes, components, user stories, and EIS docs), `wiki-conventions` (Use before editing, adding, or reconciling any wiki page under docs/wiki/)
- **Agents** (4): `eis-author` (Generates a new Executable Implementation Spec (EIS) from a natural-language description, grounded in the actual codebase), `wiki-linter` (Health-checks the wiki DAG), `wiki-maintainer` (Drains docs/wiki/.pending/changes.jsonl into wiki page updates, reconciling raw-source changes against existing wiki pages per the schema contract), `wiki-spider` (BFS traversal of the wiki DAG from an entry node to produce a structured brief about a feature…)
- **Commands** (8): `audit` (Health-check the wiki DAG — finds orphans, broken links, stale pages, contradictions, and missing entities), `create-feature` (Create a new EIS from a natural-language description, verified against the codebase), `doc-guide` (Display wiki conventions and editing rules — the contract every wiki edit must satisfy), `explore-feature` (Learn about any feature by spidering the wiki DAG — usage: /explore-feature <feature-name> [--depth N]), `init` (One-time bootstrap — populate docs/wiki/ from existing codebase sources (Prisma models, API routes, stories, EIS)), `product-map` (Enumerate project domain entities, endpoints, stories, and EIS from authoritative sources — never hallucinate), `spec-guide` (Display the EIS (Executable Implementation Spec) writing guide — template, naming, sections, grounding rules), `sync` (Manually trigger wiki reconciliation — drains .pending/changes.jsonl into wiki pages)
- **Hooks** (1): `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install llm-wiki@claude-community` from `esxr/llm-wiki`.
